parts.title: Listening Part 5
parts.instructions: You will hear Victoria talking to her dad about where her friends stayed on holiday. Where did each person stay? For each question, write a letter (A–H).

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: So Victoria, did your friends have a good holiday?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: Yes, most of them did.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Good. Where did Liam go?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: He went to a lake, somewhere near here. They took a tent.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Oh, so he stayed at a <u>campsite</u>?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: Yes. He said it was fun.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: What about Daniel? Where did he go?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: He went to the beach with his family. They wanted to stay in a hotel but there were no rooms.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Oh no.

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: It was OK. <u>They rented an apartment</u> instead. It was really nice.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Good. And Melissa?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: She went to Spain. <u>They stayed in a really big hotel</u> with a pool.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Lovely! And what about Alba?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: She went somewhere really cool. <u>They stayed in an old castle</u>!

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Wow! That sounds amazing.

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: Yes, she said it was beautiful but a bit cold at night.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: And Martin?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: He didn't go far. <u>He stayed at his friend's house</u> in the next town.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: That's nice. What about Olivia?

script.speaker: Victoria
script.text: <u>She stayed in a small guest house</u> by the sea. She said the food there was excellent.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Sounds like everyone had a great time.

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 4
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.passage:
Competition winner

I'm Sophie and I won a wonderful (1) .......... in a competition! My teacher told us about this competition, and I decided to enter.

I won a (2) .......... to Guadeloupe, a beautiful island in the Caribbean. When I arrived, I (3) .......... a man at the airport. He drove me to the hotel and was my guide.

The people in Guadeloupe (4) .......... French and Creole. I could understand some French from my lessons at school.

I (5) .......... at the hotel for a week. I went swimming in the sea every day and visited many interesting places.

Guadeloupe is now my (6) .......... place in the world. I want to go back again next year!

parts.sampleAnswer: Last weekend, my friends and I went to the beach to play volleyball. We were having a great time playing together. Suddenly, the ball went into the sea. My friend Tom ran into the water to get it back. He got very wet but we all laughed and continued playing.

parts.title: Listening Part 5
parts.instructions: You will hear Matthew talking to Alice about courses their friends took while they were on holiday. Which course did each friend take? For each question, write a letter (A–H).

script.speaker: Matthew
script.text: How was your holiday, Alice?

script.speaker: Alice
script.text: Great, thanks, Matthew. My course was really interesting.

script.speaker: Matthew
script.text: What did you learn?

script.speaker: Alice
script.text: <u>How to write stories and news articles</u>.

script.speaker: Matthew
script.text: Really? That sounds interesting.

script.speaker: Alice
script.text: Ahmet did a course, too. <u>He learned how to prepare Chinese dishes</u> on holiday – he wants to work as a food writer when he leaves school.

script.speaker: Matthew
script.text: Zena went to the same holiday camp, didn't she?

script.speaker: Alice
script.text: Yes, but she didn't need to do lots of reading and writing for her course. <u>She had a week of Spanish dancing lessons</u>.

script.speaker: Matthew
script.text: What about Zena's sister, Leah?

script.speaker: Alice
script.text: <u>She learned to work with silver and made a beautiful necklace and earrings</u>. I saw them yesterday.

script.speaker: Matthew
script.text: That's amazing! Is Mick still on holiday?

script.speaker: Alice
script.text: No, he had to come home on Monday to do a music exam. But before that, <u>he did a windsurfing and sailing course</u> at Lake Jarvis.

script.speaker: Matthew
script.text: Cool! When does Ellie come home?

script.speaker: Alice
script.text: Next week. <u>She's doing a short course on biology</u> this week. It's all about water plants and she loves it.

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 4
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.passage:
The Tree Hotel

The Tree Hotel is an unusual hotel in a forest in Sweden. People travel from all around the world to (1) .......... in this hotel because its seven rooms are at the top of trees. Each room looks very different, but you have to (2) .......... up to all of them – there are no lifts!

The newest one, '7th Room', is the largest, with beds for five people. It's also the (3) .......... of the seven rooms, as it's 10 metres up in a tree. It even has a (4) .......... for guests to wash in, too.

Another room is (5) .......... 'The Mirrorcube' because it has mirrors on all its outside walls. The hotel is near the Lule River, a good place to (6) .......... fishing.

parts.sampleAnswer: Olivia packed her football for a camping holiday with her dad. He wanted to go walking in the mountains, but Olivia wasn't interested. When they arrived at the campsite, they met Olivia's friends and their dad. Olivia played football with her friends, while their dads went walking. Everyone was happy!
